design_rationale:
WORKLOG task 1 — balloon_maturity_and_title (env_0066), matured-balloon refinance tree.

[Step 0 draw] draw_counts.py --task 1 -> {"prerequisite_problems": 2, "problems": 3, "factor_counts": [5, 6, 5]}. Assignment: balloon_ext_payoff_quote 5, balloon_ext_refinance_precondition_payment 5, balloon_ext_balloon_refinance 6.
[Scope snapshot] Occupied by task 0: balloon_ext_return_mileage_charge, balloon_ext_return_wear_charge, balloon_ext_return_fee, balloon_ext_return_balance_plan and their four tools (the returned-vehicle side). Claimed here: the maturity/refinance side — payoff quote (issue_payoff_quote_72ecc9f3, agent), pre-refinance payment (pay_refinance_precondition_amount_08a17076, user), balloon refinance (complete_balloon_refinance_14b47e8c, agent). Union of the two tasks = all 7 extended policies; scopes and tool sets are disjoint; nothing is left idle.
[Design thesis] Surface goal: "My balloon payment on the Halvard came due on the fifth and I want to refinance it with you instead of paying it off." Scored core: the refinance installment 742.24. Hidden chain: the refinance installment is fixed only after a payoff quote dated today stands and not until the customer has made the payment Kestrel requires before a refinance; that payment itself waits on the same quote. Depth 2 (refinance -> payment -> quote) plus a direct refinance -> quote edge (diamond). Breadth: 16 factors over the contract dates, tier and balances, 45 ledger rows (late charges in and out of the 12-month window, a returned payment 18 months back, ten autopay payments, the refinance election and its lead), and three other product lines (active retail, closed pre-owned, no lease). The agent must see that no quote stands and the September installment and fees are unpaid, compute a quote under the quote schedule (good-through anchor, post-maturity rate, courtesy days), compute the customer's payment (other amounts due from that quote plus a refinance down payment built from a schedule), hand it to the customer, and only then compute the refinance (amount = quote less today's payment; APR and term from schedules).

[Problem-tree card]
root: balloon_ext_balloon_refinance (agent). edges:
 1 balloon_ext_refinance_precondition_payment -> balloon_ext_payoff_quote: value_input, gate cp_quote_amount, form state, sentence "The pre-refinance payment is not fixed until a payoff quote dated on the payment date stands on the contract." (negated). Only issue_payoff_quote_72ecc9f3 books balloon_payoff_quote entries in this difficulty, so the state singles out that write.
 2 balloon_ext_balloon_refinance -> balloon_ext_payoff_quote: state_gate (round 2; was value_input), gate balloon_transactions.event_type, form state, "The refinance installment is fixed only after a payoff quote dated on the refinance date stands on the contract." (affirmative). Same single writer. It gates rather than moves the value: the amount refinanced is the quote less the held payment, and the held payment is itself the quote less the balloon plus the down payment, so the quoted figure cancels (auditor O-1.1).
 3 balloon_ext_balloon_refinance -> balloon_ext_refinance_precondition_payment: value_input, gate paid_on_refinance_date, form state (round 2; was action), "The refinance installment is not fixed until a payment dated on the refinance date stands held on the contract with nothing yet applied to it." The state is record-visible: a balloon_payment dated the refinance date with interest_applied, principal_applied and fees_applied all 0.00. Only pay_refinance_precondition_amount_08a17076 leaves such an entry (the return balance payment books fees_applied = amount; base postings apply interest first), so the state singles out one write and no fallback is needed (auditor O-S1, C-P1).
Four-point test: each sentence has an explicit connective (not until / only after); all three wait on a record-visible state (a payoff quote entry dated that day; a held, unapplied payment dated that day); no tool name, id or code token appears; strength is exactly the edge. Directions mix (1 affirmative, 2 negated). value_input edges: 2 (payment<-quote, refinance<-payment) >= max(2-1,1).
Why false at frozen_time: no balloon_payoff_quote entry exists among the 45 ledger rows; no payment is dated 2026-10-22 (last payment 2026-08-05, days_past_due 47, past_due_amount 27027.91). Flips: step 8 books the quote dated 2026-10-22 (27235.19); step 10 posts the 3667.19 payment dated 2026-10-22.
Order: quote, payment, refinance — the only topological order (the payment waits on the quote; the refinance waits on both). Deletion sensitivity: skip the quote -> the payment and refinance computes raise (no payoff quote dated today) and the quote entry is missing; skip the payment -> refinance installment 857.73 instead of 742.24 (amount refinanced 27235.19).
user_scenario never mentions a quote, a past-due installment, a down payment or a payment to be made first; payment lines are passive and fire only when the agent says so or hands the payment over. Tools validate nothing: the refinance tool books whatever it is given, the payment tool posts any amount, the quote tool records any quote.

[Base-invariant card]
step 8 (balloon_payoff_quote): balloon_payoff_and_refunds.quote_status "A payoff quote can be issued only while the contract status is active, repo_assigned, repossessed or deficiency." — status active, bound to balloon_contract_id. Satisfied.
step 10 (balloon_payment): balloon_payment_posting.payable_status — status active (the gate is also listed as retired by the return-balance overwrite, which is scoped to returned contracts; here it simply holds). balloon_reinstatement_and_redemption: policy_scope (never repossessed). Posting clauses kept: phone_ivr_ach carries no channel fee, no certified-funds restriction (certified_funds_only_until empty); the allocation clause is replaced for this payment only (held until booking).
step 12 (balloon_refinance / balloon_terms_modified): balloon_refinancing.refi_status (active); refi_open "The request may be taken no earlier than refinance_window_open_days_before calendar days before maturity_date." — window opened 2026-08-06, request 2026-10-22; refi_close (time): anchor maturity_date 2026-10-05, duration refinance_window_close_days_after 30 (Tier 2), counted from 2026-10-06, completion on the last day 2026-11-04 timely; 2026-10-22 is day 17 (just before boundary: 2026-11-04 timely; past it, 2026-11-05, not). refi_history is replaced, for a refinance under this rule only, by the held-payment test; its late-charge limit is kept verbatim in the replaced_by and holds: 2 late charges in the 12 months ending 2026-10-22 against refinance_max_late_charges_12m 2 for Tier 2. "A refinance may be completed only once per contract": refinance_date empty.
[Business-object card] Object: balloon contract 4386051729 (Tier 2, matured 2026-10-05, refinance elected 2026-08-25). Key: balloon_contract_id on the quote, payment and refinance entries. Included: principal 26801.97, fees 50.00 (late charges 2026-09-16 and 2026-10-16), interest paid to 2026-08-05, the election, late charges and returned payment by window, autopay payments. Excluded by window: the 2024-12-16 late charge (paid, 22 months old), the 2025-04-08 returned payment from 12-month counts (18 months). Settled: the 2024-12-16 late charge (with the 2025-01-05 payment) and the returned-payment fee (with the 2025-04-10 payment).
[Overwrites — hygiene] quote: retires the base good-through sentence (replaced_by keeps the 10-day ceiling and the requester-earlier clause for every other quote) and the per diem/payoff sentence (replaced_by keeps the per diem and payoff structure, scoped to customer payoff quotes under this rule). payment: retires the allocation-order sentence for the pre-refinance payment only, quoting the base order in full for every other payment. refinance: retires "The amount refinanced is the balloon_amount; any other amount due must be paid separately before the refinance." (replaced_by keeps "every other amount due is still paid separately"), the term/APR sentence (replaced_by keeps the term ceiling and the relationship_refinance_rate_reduction_pct value for one current account), and the refi_history sentence (replaced_by keeps the late-charge limit). Each differs in this world: base quote 27320.13 vs 27235.19; base payment allocation would apply the 3667.19 to interest and principal and leave the fees and the past-due flag in place; base amount refinanced 26200.00 vs 23568.00; base APR 7.99 less 0.25 = 7.74 over 48 months vs 8.34 over 36.

[Factor cards — figures from the harness on the handling-time worlds]
Payoff quote (gold 27235.19; all-baseline 27320.13 = 26801.97 + 50.00 + 5.32 x 88):
 1 qt_good_through (method; anchor): quote date after maturity -> good through the quote date; baseline +10 days -> 27293.89.
 2 qt_post_maturity_rate (parameter; election option and lead, both read from the same election row, so not counted as multi-source — auditor O-1.4): refinance election 41 days before maturity -> post-maturity days at 7.99 (5.87/day); baseline contract apr -> 27229.69. Near-miss: a return election recorded later would switch the latest election and drop to the contract apr (probe: 27229.69).
 3 qt_grace_courtesy (parameter): two late charges in 12 months -> 3 days; baseline 0 -> 27252.80. Near-miss: the 2024-12-16 late charge is outside the window.
 4 qt_relationship_courtesy (parameter; cross retail): one current line -> 2 days; baseline 0 -> 27246.93. Near-miss: the closed pre-owned contract is not a current line.
 5 qt_autopay_courtesy (parameter): 10 autopay payments -> 2 days; baseline 0 -> 27246.93. Near-miss: the 2025-10-05 autopay payment is outside the 12 months; the 2025-04-10 phone payment is not autopay.
Pre-refinance payment (gold 3667.19; all-baseline 1035.19 = other amounts due only):
 1 cp_down_standing (parameter; round 2 ladder: Tier 4/5 -> down_pct_subprime 10; Tier 2/3 with at least one late charge in 12 months -> 7.5; Tier 1/1+ or clean Tier 2/3 -> none): Tier 2 with two late charges -> 7.5 points; baseline 0 -> 1702.19.
 2 cp_vehicle_age (method): 36 whole months -> flat 2.5 points (not the 48-month sliding add-on); baseline none -> 3012.19.
 3 cp_returned_payments (parameter): returned payment 18 months back -> 1.0 point; baseline 0 -> 3405.19.
 4 cp_relationship_credit (parameter; cross retail): one current line -> 150.00; baseline 0 -> 3817.19.
 5 cp_autopay_credit (parameter): 10 autopay payments -> 100.00; baseline 0 -> 3767.19.
Refinance (gold 742.24; all-baseline 575.25 = 23568.00 at 7.99 over 48 months):
 1 ri_relationship_rate (parameter; cross retail): one current line -> 0.25 off; baseline 0 -> 744.97.
 2 ri_late_charge_addon (parameter; multi-source late count OR/AND returned count, round 2): two late charges in 12 months (no returned payment in 12 months; 2025-04-08 is 18 months old) -> +0.50; baseline 0 -> 736.80.
 3 ri_autopay_discount (parameter): 10 autopay payments -> 0.25 off; baseline 0 -> 744.97.
 4 ri_timing_surcharge (parameter; date): 17 days after maturity -> +0.50; baseline 0 -> 736.80.
 5 ri_completed_loans (parameter; cross preowned): one completed line (pre-owned closed) -> 0.15 off; baseline 0 -> 743.87.
 6 ri_term_schedule (method): 36 months in service -> fixed cut 48 - 12 = 36; baseline 48 -> 579.13.
Task floors: multi-source factor ri_late_charge_addon (round 2: every rung combines the 12-month late-charge count with the 12-month returned-payment count, two distinct record sets); cross-difficulty factors 4 (retail x3, preowned x1); every computation reads a cross value (CFIELD days_past_due).
[Factor independence] qt_* each read their own records (dates, election rows, late/autopay counts, retail/preowned/lease days_past_due); plain bindings per_diem, quote_days, pre_maturity_days, post_maturity_days, post_per_diem and result assemble. cp_* read late/returned/autopay counts, contract_date and the other lines; plain cp_quote_amount/other_due read the quote; down_payment and result assemble. ri_* read their own counts, dates and lines; plain ri_quote_amount, paid_on_refinance_date, amount_refinanced, refinance_apr_value, monthly_rate and result assemble. No factor's tier reads another factor's binding.
[Method tier pairwise tables] qt_good_through: quote-date vs maturity anchor differ whenever maturity is after the quote date (quote 2026-09-28, maturity 2026-10-05: 0 vs 7 days); quote-date vs +10 differ always; maturity vs +10 differ whenever maturity is fewer than 10 days out (maturity in 7 days: 7 vs 10). cp_vehicle_age: sliding (0.1 point per month beyond 22, applying from 48 months, so at least 2.6) vs flat 2.5 never coincide (48 months: 2.6 vs 2.5); flat vs none differ always (2.5 vs 0); sliding vs none differ always. ri_term_schedule (after r1 fix): sliding (maximum less 12 less one month for each month from 48 on, floor 6) vs fixed cut (maximum less 12) differ at every input of the sliding tier (48 months, Tier 2: 35 vs 36); fixed cut vs maximum differ always (by 12); sliding vs maximum differ always (by 13 or more).
[Edge-probe table] charged-off retail contract inserted ahead of the active one -> 27235.19 / 3667.19 / 742.24 unchanged (status filter). Older pay_balloon election 2026-07-15 -> unchanged (latest election governs). Later return election 2026-09-30 -> quote 27229.69, payment 3661.69, refinance 742.24 (latest election now return, lead 5 days -> contract apr; the refinance is unchanged because the amount refinanced is quote less payment). Stale quote dated 2026-10-01 -> unchanged (only a quote dated the payment/refinance date counts). No retail contract -> 27246.93 / 3828.93 / 740.23 (no current line; no completed-retail line either, pre-owned still completed). No quote dated today -> the payment and refinance computes have no starting payoff (prerequisite case). Zero-division/None: refinance_term >= 6; monthly_rate > 0 for every tier; CFIELD reads are guarded by EXISTS; interest_paid_to_date and maturity_date are set on every active contract.
[compute_basis sweep] harness basis_sweep: every compute_basis quote, baseline sentence, replaced_by and policy_source is verbatim in its own rule — "basis sweep misses: 0". Reverse: every quantity/window/branch/floor/rounding sentence is claimed (good-through anchors, post-maturity rate, courtesy days and their floor at zero, per diem rounding, down-payment points and credits with the zero floor, amount refinanced, the five rate adjustments and two-decimal APR, the term schedule with its 12-month floor, installment rounding).
[Seed design] customers: Marcus Thibodeaux (band: phone 3135547261, tax 4815, ZIP 80209, 455 S Pearl St, Denver CO). balloon_contracts: Tier 2, account 4386051729, VIN 1KSBT8C56PN447120 (serial 447120), CO, contract 2023-09-28, first installment 2023-11-05, maturity 2026-10-05, 36 installments of 827.91 at 7.24% with a 26200.00 balloon (50% of MSRP 52400.00, the Tier 2 36-month percentage), principal 26801.97 (above the balloon because of the late 2024-12 payment and the 2025-04 returned payment), fees 50.00, interest paid to 2026-08-05, days_past_due 47, past_due_amount 27027.91 (September installment plus balloon), autopay unenrolled after August, refinance elected. balloon_transactions (45): funding; 34 installment payments posted on simple interest (online until 2024-12, autopay from 2025-01, a 2024-12-19 late payment, the 2025-04-05 autopay returned 2025-04-08 and replaced by phone on 2025-04-10 with its 25.00 fee); late charges 2024-12-16 (paid), 2026-09-16 and 2026-10-16 (unpaid; the balloon's grace ended 2026-10-15); maturity options letter 2026-07-07; refinance election 2026-08-25. retail_contracts: Tier 1, account 4127703958, VIN 3KSRP6D23RN461835, active, 72 months at 7.24 (Tier 1 61-72 band), installment 708.21, 28 installments paid through 2026-10-20, next_due_date 2026-11-20, principal 27295.99 (amortized), days_past_due 0. preowned_contracts: Tier 2, account 4205518364, VIN 2KSPC3A14EN418277, 48 months at 9.24 (Tier 2 37-48 band), installment 374.49, paid in full 2020-06-30, closed 2020-07-06. No lease. Every row decides a tier or a near-miss; the automatic clauses are respected (both late charges assessed after the 10-day grace; no repossession assignment at 47 days for Tier 2, whose minimum is 75 days; the refinance window is open; no overpayment can arise).
[Persona design] Marcus, loud and friendly wrestling coach. Volunteers the goal (refinance the matured balloon today, keep the truck) and the true opening facts (balloon due on the fifth; he told Kestrel in August he would refinance — the 2026-08-25 election). Gives phone to be located, phone + SSN last four + ZIP to verify (DOB spare), account number and other Kestrel holdings only when asked; says he does not know balances or rates; takes whatever term and rate the program gives. Passive: agrees when told something must be worked out or paid first; pays the handed-over amount from checking ending 4630 and reads back the receipt; ends when told the refinance is done and the new payment. He never names a quote, a down payment or the missed September installment.
[Tool capability cards] issue_payoff_quote_72ecc9f3 (agent, write): one balloon_payoff_quote entry dated today, purpose customer_payoff, with the given amount, good-through date and per diem; balances untouched; receipt with id, date, purpose, amount, good-through, per diem. pay_refinance_precondition_amount_08a17076 (user, write): one balloon_payment dated today on phone_ivr_ach, purpose installment, applied portions 0.00 (held on the contract unapplied), last_payment_date today; no trigger fires (purpose installment, no fee portion). complete_balloon_refinance_14b47e8c (agent, write): one balloon_refinance entry plus the terms_modified effects the base trigger maps (apr, monthly_payment, refinance_date, balloon_amount 0.00) and the booking effects (principal = amount refinanced, fees cleared and booked as one balloon_fee_payment entry linked to the payment dated today, fees 0.00, interest paid to today, nothing past due, next due one month out, maturity today plus the term, maturity_option_elected refinance); date arithmetic is a static helper.
[Standard solution] 0 find_customers(3135547261) -> 1 verify (3135547261, 4815, 80209) -> 2 find_balloon_contracts -> 3 find_balloon_transactions (no quote; late charges, returned payment, autopay, election) -> 4 find_retail_contracts -> 5 find_preowned_contracts -> 6 find_lease_contracts -> 7/8 unlock+call issue_payoff_quote_72ecc9f3(good-through 2026-10-22, per diem 5.32, amount 27235.19) -> 9 unlock_user + 10 customer calls pay_refinance_precondition_amount_08a17076(3667.19, 4630) -> 11/12 unlock+call complete_balloon_refinance_14b47e8c(23568.00, 36, 8.34, 742.24).
[Verification run] Harness on handling-time worlds (real tools): quote 27235.19 (baseline 27320.13), payment 3667.19 (1035.19), refinance 742.24 (575.25); factor sensitivities as listed; prerequisite sensitivity: payment->quote raises without the quote, refinance->quote raises, refinance->payment 857.73. Per-task gates for task 1: EXTENDED OK, REPLAY OK (13 actions, closure 49 = init 49), SOLVABILITY OK, COMPUTE OK (3 comps, 16 factors, 4 cross, 41 history rows, 73 branches), GROUNDING OK, SCOPE OK.
[Closure] quote -> issue_payoff_quote_72ecc9f3 -> step 8 amount -> quote entry 27235.19; payment -> pay_refinance_precondition_amount_08a17076 -> step 10 amount -> payment 3667.19 held; refinance -> complete_balloon_refinance_14b47e8c -> step 12 refinance_monthly_payment -> refinance entry and re-amortized contract (principal 23568.00, apr 8.34, installment 742.24, maturity 2029-10-22). Scope = required_documents = computations; tools in first-call order. solvability: step 8 quote_status; step 10 payable_status (active) and reinstatement policy_scope; step 12 refi_status, refi_open, refi_close (+ temporal_feasibility).
[Real-conversation walk] Opening gives object (the Halvard's matured balloon), timing (today), mode (refinance with Kestrel). Agent locates, verifies, reads contract and ledger (no quote; September installment and two late charges unpaid; refinance elected), reads the refinance rule's sentences, explains a quote and a payment are needed first; Marcus agrees. Agent issues the quote, figures the payment, hands it over; Marcus pays from 4630 and the receipt enters the transcript; agent books the refinance and states 742.24 for 36 months; Marcus ends. All in one frozen_time; nothing waits on clearing (the funds are held and applied at booking per the rule).
[Draft recomputation from visible context] From the published rules and the records alone: quote good through 2026-10-22 (after maturity), 61 days at 5.32 and 17 - 3 - 2 - 2 = 10 days at the refinance-rate per diem 5.87 -> 27235.19; payment 27235.19 - 26200.00 + 26200.00 x 11% - 150.00 - 100.00 = 3667.19; refinance on 23568.00 at 8.34 over 36 months -> 742.24. Same as gold; no tie in rounding (per diem 5.3163 and 5.8671; installment far from a half cent).
[Revision log] r1: method-tier review found the term schedule's sliding and fixed tiers equal at exactly 48 months (36 each) and the fixed tier equal to the maximum for Tier 5 -> changed the fixed tier to "maximum less 12" and the sliding tier to "maximum less 12 less one month per month from 48 on, floor 6"; vehicle-age slope now counts beyond 22 months so the sliding add-on starts at 2.6, never 2.5. Gold unchanged (36 months, flat tiers); traces, tracing and this dossier updated; gates re-run green.


REWORK round 2 (audit policy_task r1: T1-F1, C-F1, C-P1 and observations)
- T1-F1: retail row next_due_date 2026-11-20 (28 installments from 2024-07-20 paid through 2026-10-20); installment 708.21 and principal 27295.99 now follow the Tier 1 72-month amortization at 7.24; pre-owned row apr 9.24 (Tier 2 37-48 band), installment 374.49. Seed realism sweep of every row: balloon next_due 2026-09-05 / 34 paid / dpd 47 / past due 27027.91 consistent; retail 28 paid + 44 remaining = 72; pre-owned paid in full before its last due date, closed.
- C-F1 member 4: cp_down_standing rewritten (no vacuous Tier 4/5 late-charge clause; own parameter down_pct_subprime instead of the origination min_down_payment_pct, closing G3). Members 1-3 are task 0 policies (fixed charter-wide, see task 0 dossier).
- C-P1 / O-S1: the refinance <- pre-refinance payment edge is now state form (held payment dated the refinance date with nothing applied); fallback_reason removed. O-S2: the refi_history replaced_by no longer restates the edge as an action. O-1.1: refinance <- quote edge is now state_gate. O-1.2: the quote tool's per_diem argument says it is the per diem at the contract's own APR. O-1.3: VINs in this dossier corrected to the seeded values. O-1.4: qt_post_maturity_rate no longer called multi-source; ri_late_charge_addon made genuinely multi-source. O-T1: tool descriptions carry no ordering words ("ahead of", "toward the refinance", "applied by this booking" removed). O-T2: the refinance tool books a balloon_fee_payment entry for the fees it clears. G1: every days_past_due read is now existential and exact (CFIELD with status active and days_past_due 0), so a second, past-due holding of a line cannot hide a current one. G2: term schedule wording now says term_long_months itself counts as one month.
- Method pairwise table (re-run): qt_good_through (quote date / maturity / +10) distinct on every pair as before; cp_vehicle_age sliding (>= 2.6) vs flat 2.5 vs none distinct; ri_term_schedule sliding (max-12-k, k>=1, floor 6) vs cut (max-12) vs max distinct at every input.
- Factor independence (re-run, transitive): qt_* read dates, election rows, late/autopay counts and existential current-line reads; cp_* read late/returned/autopay counts, contract_date and existential current-line reads; ri_* read late/returned/autopay counts, dates, existential current-line and completed-line reads; plain bindings assemble. No factor reads another factor's binding.
- compute_basis sweep: 0 misses (quotes, baseline sentences, replaced_by, policy_source).
- Probe table (re-run): second active retail at days_past_due 30 inserted ahead of the current one -> 27235.19 / 3667.19 / 742.24 unchanged (existential read); retail past due -> no current line, quote 27246.93, payment 3817.19, refinance 744.97 (rule's no-line tiers); no retail -> same as past due; stale quote dated 2026-10-01 and older pay_balloon election -> unchanged.
- Gold and every sensitivity figure unchanged; gates re-run green.


REWORK round 3 (pre-render hardening; revision_2 passed with charter=CLEAN)
- O2-1.1: factor_trace labels no longer call qt_post_maturity_rate or cp_down_standing multi-source; the task's multi-source factor is ri_late_charge_addon (late-charge count and returned-payment count). Its factor_sensitivity tier label now names the rung actually taken (two or more late charges or a returned payment).
- O2-2: the refinance <- quote effect text no longer refers to "this edge"; it says the quote enables the refinance installment without moving its value.
- Recipe 6: the quote rule states that of two maturity elections recorded the same day the first recorded counts as the most recent; the pre-refinance payment and refinance rules state that of two payoff quotes dated that day the one issued first is used (the DSL keeps the first row on a tie).
- Recipe 7: each of the three rules states the counting convention (calendar days count the later date only; whole months complete when the later date reaches the earlier day of the month, month-end included; N-month windows take dates on or before the anchor fewer than N whole months before it).
- Recipe 8-9: "every other payoff quote / payment" clauses now say those are issued or posted outside this rule and its tool.
- Probes (round 3): a second election recorded the same day as return_vehicle and recorded later -> 27235.19 / 3667.19 / 742.24 unchanged (first recorded governs). compute_basis sweep 0 misses; gold and every sensitivity unchanged.


REWORK round 4 (C3-X9)
- The quote's second replaced_by now restates the base per diem and payoff wording for quotes issued outside this rule and its tool (third-party purposes) instead of deferring to the retired clause. This task's customer payoff quote is in scope; compute, gold and sensitivities unchanged.


REWORK round 5 (KB audit source items)
- SRC-1: the quote's second replaced_by now restates, for quotes outside the rule and its tool, the per diem as the base formula computes it (principal_balance times apr divided by 100 divided by per_diem_day_basis, rounded to the cent).
- SRC-3: the quote rule defines the days after maturity plainly ("The quote interest days after maturity_date are those that fall after maturity_date; the other quote interest days fall on or before it.") and the post-maturity factor alone owns the daily rate for those days (decides post_per_diem; baseline the per diem). The combination sentence stays generic. Figures unchanged: post-maturity daily rate 5.87 on this world, baseline 27229.69 for that factor.
- SRC-2: the down-payment returned-payment rung now reads "one or more posted"; this world (one returned payment 18 months back) unaffected.
user_scenario:
You are Marcus Thibodeaux, 42, a high-school wrestling coach in Denver, calling Kestrel Financial Services from the gym office between practices. You are friendly, a little loud, and you talk in short bursts. In 2023 you bought a Kestrel Halvard on a Kestrel Advantage balloon contract, and the big balloon payment came due on October 5. Back in August you told Kestrel you'd refinance it rather than pay it off or hand the truck back, and you want that done now. Open by saying exactly this: "My balloon payment on the Halvard came due on the fifth and I want to refinance it with you instead of paying it off. I'd like to get the refinance done today so I can keep the truck." Getting the balloon refinanced on this call is the whole reason you are calling.
You don't hand out details until asked. When the agent asks how to find you, give your phone number, 3135547261. When the agent asks you to verify, give your phone number 3135547261, the last four of your Social Security number, 4815, and your billing ZIP code, 80209; if they want one more thing, your date of birth is 1984-02-09. If they ask for the account number, it is 4386051729. If they ask whether you have anything else with Kestrel, say yes, you've got a Kestrel Taggart pickup financed with them right now, and years ago you financed a used Kestrel Corvalis with them that you paid off; you don't know those account numbers. You don't know your exact balance, your interest rate or any payoff figure, and if asked you say the agent will have all that in front of them. If the agent asks what term or rate you want, say you'll take whatever Kestrel's refinance program gives you, you just want to keep the truck.
If the agent says something has to be worked out or paid before the refinance can go through, say okay, that makes sense, go ahead.
